description: The `${s1; s2}` handler form inside an `<each>` row, call-led and reading the row item, runs both statements in order: `last` is `a:5`, `count` ends 0. Pre-S437 impl#1 kept only the first statement (the each-row gap covered the `${…}` form and the inline block alike; the call-led gap covered it at top level).
rationale: The top-level sibling `expr-handler-call-first-multi-stmt` pins "both run" for `${f(); g()}`; §5.2.3 (amended S435): "a statement's effect SHALL NOT depend on whether an earlier statement is a call or an assignment, or on whether the handler sits at top level … or inside an `<each>` row (§17.7)."
